7use crate::common::BitMatrix;
8use crate::common::Result;
9use crate::Exceptions;
10
11/**
12* <p>Encapsulates data masks for the data bits in a QR  and micro QR code, per ISO 18004:2006 6.8.</p>
13*
14* <p>Note that the diagram in section 6.8.1 is misleading since it indicates that i is column position
15* and j is row position. In fact, as the text says, i is row position and j is column position.</p>
16*/
17pub fn GetDataMaskBit(maskIndex: u32, x: u32, y: u32, isMicro: Option<bool>) -> Result<bool> {
18    let isMicro = isMicro.unwrap_or(false);
19    let mut maskIndex = maskIndex;
20    if isMicro {
21        if !(0..4).contains(&maskIndex) {
22            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(
23                "QRCode maskIndex out of range",
24            ));
25        }
26        maskIndex = [1, 4, 6, 7][maskIndex as usize]; // map from MQR to QR indices
27    }
28
29    match maskIndex {
30        0 => return Ok((y + x) % 2 == 0),
31        1 => return Ok(y % 2 == 0),
32        2 => return Ok(x % 3 == 0),
33        3 => return Ok((y + x) % 3 == 0),
34        4 => return Ok(((y / 2) + (x / 3)) % 2 == 0),
35        5 => return Ok((y * x) % 6 == 0),
36        6 => return Ok(((y * x) % 6) < 3),
37        7 => return Ok((y + x + ((y * x) % 3)) % 2 == 0),
38        _ => {}
39    }
40
41    Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(
42        "QRCode maskIndex out of range",
43    ))
44}

46#[allow(dead_code)]
47pub fn GetMaskedBit(
48    bits: &BitMatrix,
49    x: u32,
50    y: u32,
51    maskIndex: u32,
52    isMicro: Option<bool>,
53) -> Result<bool> {
54    Ok(GetDataMaskBit(maskIndex, x, y, isMicro)? != bits.get(x, y))
55}
